paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络随深度增加出现的退化问题（degradation problem），提出了残差学习框架，让堆叠层学习相对于输入的残差映射而非无参照的映射 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上验证了极深残差网络（最高 152 层）比对应的普通网络更易优化，并能从深度增加中获得精度提升 [S1.p7]。152 层残差网络单模型在 ImageNet 验证集上取得 4.49% 的 top-5 误差，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的 top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上训练了 100 层和 1000 层以上的模型 [S1.p8]，并将残差网络用于目标检测等任务，在 ILSVRC & COCO 2015 多个赛道获得第一名 [S1.p9]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的问题是：学习更好的网络是否像堆叠更多层一样简单 [S1.p2]。作者指出，当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题：随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。作者认为退化表明并非所有系统都同样容易优化 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?

When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不期望每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标底层映射 H(x)，而是显式地让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。该形式通过前馈神经网络中的“捷径连接”实现，捷径连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$.
The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2).
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical, and thus $W_{s}$ is only used when matching dimensions.

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 误差率 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者比较了 18 层和 34 层普通网络与残差网络，并构建了 50、101、152 层的瓶颈残差网络 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS1.p13][S4.SS1.p14]。此外，在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，训练了 20 至 1202 层的网络 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p8]。还在 PASCAL VOC 和 MS COCO 上以 Faster R-CNN 为检测方法评估了目标检测性能 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We first evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer plain nets.
We replace each 2-layer block in the 34-layer net with this 3-layer bottleneck block, resulting in a 50-layer ResNet (Table 1).
We construct 101-layer and 152-layer ResNets by using more 3-layer blocks (Table 1).
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
We compare $n=\{3,5,7,9\}$, leading to 20, 32, 44, and 56-layer networks.
We set $n=200$ that leads to a 1202-layer network, which is trained as described above.
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络有更高的验证误差，且在整个训练过程中训练误差更高，即出现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。残差学习逆转了这一情况：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比对应的普通网络将 top-1 误差降低了 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层网络准确率更高，未观察到退化问题 [S4.SS1.p15]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高，而 ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p8]。在目标检测上，用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 在 COCO 上使 mAP@[.5,.95] 提高 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
the 34-layer plain net has higher training error throughout the whole training procedure
the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).
We do not observe the degradation problem and thus enjoy significant accuracy gains from considerably increased depth.
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
on the challenging COCO dataset we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement.

limitations.text: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相似，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者在 CIFAR-10 上未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并表示结合更强的正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者提到深度普通网络优化困难的原因尚待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
